description:
[read-only] The Schedule → Failed backlog of the brand: one row per platform of a post that did not go out, with its row `id`, postId, contentId, account, slot, lastError, reasonClass and `coverage` ("live" / "rebooked" when the platform is now covered elsewhere, null when nothing known covers it). Filters: state (open = what the tab shows, the default), platform, zernioAccountId, reasonClass, slotAfter / slotBefore. Follow `cursor` until it is null; a page can be short.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/failed.)

cursor.description: The `nextCursor` of the previous page. Omit for the first page.

fields.description: Top-level item fields to return instead of the summary. Default: a summary of each item's plain fields. For one item in full, use the matching get_ tool.

slotAfter.description: Only rows whose slot is at or after this instant (ISO 8601 with an offset).

slotBefore.description: Only rows whose slot is before this instant.

name: list_failed
title: List the Failed tab
